function.name: musicCharts_getMostPlayed
function.description: This function retrieves the most played song in a particular genre from a specified region Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

genre.description: Music genre e.g., Rock, Pop, HipHop etc.

region.description: Region where the song popularity is to be checked

duration.description: Time duration in hours for which the music played count will be considered. default is 0

We need to use the function to get the most played song in a particular genre from a specified region. The function signature: musicCharts_getMostPlayed with parameters: genre (string), region (string), duration? (number). The user didn't specify duration; we can use default. So we need to call the function twice: once for pop globally? They didn't specify region for pop. They just asked "currently most popular pop song". That could be global. So we can call with genre="Pop", region="Global" or maybe region unspecified? The function requires region. We can set region="Global" or "Worldwide". Let's assume "Global". Then second call: genre="Rock", region="Australia". We'll call the function twice.
